ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
ispickval(Background_Check_Result__c, "Reviewed & Approved")
&&
Background_Check_Returned_Date__c >= date(2019,09,16)
&&
(isblank(text(Felony__c)) || isblank(text(Felony_Last_7_Years__c)) || isblank(text(Misdemeanor__c)) || isblank(text(Misdemeanor_Last_7_Years__c)))
